title: Model calls got more forgiving
summary:
A maintenance-minded day: more reliable model requests, a cleaner SDK, and a repository that is slightly less haunted by old folders.

Model names are now sanitized and aliased before reaching gen.pollinations.ai, preventing avoidable 4xx responses. The Portkey gateway also picked up Gemini's negative-token fix, while model statistics now come from one cache instead of competing sources.

The SDK moved into a clearer packages/ layout and retired deprecated features, making the codebase easier to navigate and maintain without carrying historical luggage forever.

Assets and tools were reorganized, and the news and Reddit workflow moved into a dedicated social/ folder. Dead ad-system code was also removed, because software does not improve when its fossils are carefully preserved.
